## What changes / 変更内容

## Track, variant, and measure / 区分・問題の版・尺度

- Track / 区分: FPT / exact
- Variant / 問題の版: decision / counting / optimization / search
- Parameter or size measure / パラメータまたはサイズ尺度: k / n / m / n+m; define n and m / nとmの意味
- Input class, density, fixed constants, and weights / 入力クラス・疎密・固定定数・重み:

## Mathematical reason / 数理的な理由

State whether the consequence is explicitly in the source or derived here, and identify any quantitative specialization. / 出典に明記された系か本カタログでの導出かを示し、計算量への代入部分を明記してください。

## Sources read / 確認した一次資料

Record exact versions and theorem/lemma/section locations. / 版と定理・補題・節の参照箇所を記録してください。

## Comparison status / 既知結果との比較

Unassessed, classical benchmark only, or a documented survey? Compare the same variant, input class, measure, and computation model; do not imply novelty. / 未調査・古典的基準のみ・根拠を示した調査のいずれか。同じ問題の版・入力クラス・尺度・計算モデルで比較し、新規性を含意させないでください。

## Scope and unresolved points / 範囲と未解決点

## Checks performed / 実施した確認

- [ ] Original n/m/n+m and input bit length L are distinct from encoded N, M, w, and bit length; auxiliary variables and all stages are included.
- [ ] The density regime, numerical bit costs, preprocessing, repeated calls, and output/reconstruction costs support the bound.
- [ ] Variant-specific requirements are justified: unique extension/count preservation, objective preservation, or reconstruction, as applicable.
- [ ] The exact assumption/source version is recorded.
- [ ] Provenance and comparison labels match their evidence; assessed comparisons include bilingual notes and source references.
- [ ] English and Japanese statements agree.
- [ ] Review labels reflect work actually performed.
- [ ] Data and generated overall/FPT/EXACT indexes and entry pages are included; `python3 tools/render_catalog.py --check` succeeds.

These checks document the change and its consistency; they do not certify the SAT theorem. / これらは変更内容と整合性の確認であり、SAT定理の正しさの認定ではありません。
